text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
—One! Two! One! Two!
Not done yet!
Keep elbows up! Stay on beat!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, joined staff exercise workshop
instructed by Tucker Blair.
Program supposed to be for humans, but...

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
*gasp* *pant*...!
T-This is brutal...!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Daily lack of exercise catching up.
Still, trainers need stamina too...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! To support race horse girls,
trainers need physical strength too!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Moving own body gives real weight
to coaching!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text: Come, keep going! Next, alternate knees...!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
*gasp* *wheeze*...!
No more... out of breath...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Don't overdo it!
...Haha, bit too intense?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... workload precisely calculated.
Should be manageable barely even for
untrained humans, but...?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I give up too.
Any more will ruin tomorrow's work...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nobody collapsed, nothing hurt.
Just so utterly exhausted, dreading tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
...I see. That's why.
Very calm, sound judgment.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Rejoin whenever caught breath!
Jump in anytime!
Alright, whoever can keep going, continue!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Relieved trainers crouched down
one by one.
Yet she kept moving energetically.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
One! Two! One! Two!
Focus on biceps!
Watch and learn during break!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Drenched in sweat, Tucker Blair continued
intense exercise. Face beet red, breathing ragged.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey...! You okay!?
You shouldn't push yourself either...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
No, don't stop me!
Want to see what lies beyond limits!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Because right now, instinct shouting
"beat yourself"!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Nature! Environment! Always changing!
So face whatever comes full throttle, no holding back!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Repeating that made me strong!
No holding back, pushed limit "one step"
further each challenge!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Then what happens?
Before know it, one step becomes two.
Two steps become ten!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text: Become self who far surpassed limits!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you!
Moment we grasp "that"!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tucker Blair pushed intensity even higher.
Moved by burning passion,
found myself standing back up...
choice_data_list: I want to... break past my limits too!
I want to... break past my limits too!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
...! That's spirit!
Alright, let's go!!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa, amazing...
Alright... Just one more step for me too...!

text_block_list.name: Mid-level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
That's right...
Muscle pain builds muscle mass.
No time to look pathetic!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Fired up now, are ya?!
That's it! Show some guts—!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
UOOOOHHH!
Burn it up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, having completed the exercise, everyone...

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
W-We did it...!
We actually made it through~!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Right?!
You all fought damn hard!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of you surpassed your limits!
Now, my fine comrades!!
Next up is the afterparty! Let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Dahahahaha!
Meat! Protein!!
Nothing beats this after workout!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A lively BBQ began.
Thanks to unity forged from overcoming it together,
conversations flowed with energy...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
—Hey there, Trainer!
Eating well?
choice_data_list: Yes! Thank you so much for today!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!
I should be the one thanking you.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Earlier, because you took the lead
and followed me,
everyone else pushed through too!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
As top contributor, enjoy yourself to fullest!
Look! Place is booming everywhere—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Thick steaks over there!
Fire-starting challenge
right over here!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! I'm still hungry too!
After all that movement earlier,
we need way more protein!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Dahahahaha!
Look at that appetite!
Great to see!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, if you love meat, I know great place!
Obsessed with rock salt and natural flavors...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's go together sometime!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Still aiming to train yourself?!
Awesome! That's the spirit!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Oh, smoke! Well done!
You'd survive on deserted island
without problem!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Gotta take you along someday!
You'd be reliable! Dahahahaha!
